newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani vegoil rates seen steady next week.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani vegoil rates seen steady next week.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil rates are likely to remain steady next week as stocks have risen on fresh supplies, dealers said on Saturday.
"Prices will be stable as we have sufficient stocks and arrival of cottonseed is good. But we expect fresh import orders by Pakistan in the next 10 to 15 days," dealer Saulat Khan said.

Dealers said vegoil stocks rose to 127,000 tonnes this week from 98,000 tonnes last week. RBD palmoil and palm olein stocks rose to 87,000 tonnes from 79,000. Soybean oil and sunflower oil stocks rose to 30,000 tonnes from 16,000.
The Ghee Corporation of Pakistan (GCP) had stocks of 10,000 tonnes of palmoil and palm olein compared to 3,000 last week.
Dealers said the Wawasan Courage was discharging 11,900 tonnes of palmoil at Karachi Port. Wawasan Murni with 25,000 tonnes of palmoil was on the high seas and expected to arrive by October 31.
The Petr Shmdit with 10,000 soybean oil was due to arrive in mid-November, and the Wawasan Megah was loading 25,000 tonnes of palmoil at a Malaysian port.
